claims.statement: TargetRelationalMinenessFamily is a same-binding target-indexed relation Pi between actual bearer-centred routes and selected targets, satisfying BIND, ROUTE, PARTICIPATION, COVER, INDEX, COVARIANCE, NONEXCLUSIVITY and SEPARATION.
claims.domain: one fixed admitted P/I/K/event with predeclared route and target sets
claims.thought_experiment_role: provides a positive nonexclusive representation of bodily/action mineness without an owner object

claims.statement: For two named routes and two named targets with nonempty route sets per target, there are 9 covered matrices, 4 locally unique matrices, and 2 global-single-owner matrices; hence 7 covered countermodels and 2 locally unique countermodels lack a global single owner.
The nine covered matrices form five structural orbits under swapping the two route labels; only the all-both matrix is fixed.
claims.domain: the A4Z finite matrix family under the order-two route-label permutation group
premises: route labels treated as presentation names
claims.proof_or_source: Burnside's lemma; MODEL_PROOF.md A4Z-T2; exact enumeration
counterexamples: a unique-owner label changes under the swap
claims.thought_experiment_role: separates structural participation from arbitrary owner naming

claims.statement: Within the finite family, unique-owner labeling is overstrong and presentation-dependent, coverage is information-losing, and the target-indexed relational family is the least of the three candidates that preserves all five route-swap orbits.
claims.domain: only the three declared representations on the A4Z finite family
premises: no claim of global minimality among arbitrary representations
counterexamples: other richer covariant representations may exist
claims.thought_experiment_role: selects a candidate bridge representation without claiming phenomenal sufficiency

claims.statement: If one complete actual same-instance target-indexed participation family is independently grounded, C1/R157 conditionally transports that relational structure inside experience; B_pc^family, H_cf, conceptual self, report and subject count remain separate and open.
claims.domain: one complete actual UCT token with correctly sorted routes, targets, consumers, events and transported parameters
claims.thought_experiment_role: locates multiple nonexclusive practical centres in experience without a homuncular owner

claims.statement: A conceptual self may summarize or misdescribe Pi and a report may measure or collapse it; neither constitutes Pi or basal experience.
claims.domain: actual organization, conceptual-model and report-process types in the fixed A4Z binding
premises: no reverse inference from language or self-label
counterexamples: same Pi with swapped autobiographical report
same report with joint versus distributed Pi
claims.thought_experiment_role: keeps felt mineness, conceptual I and report distinct
